reasons: Section 4(c) as drafted only covers cessation of Services, license revocation, and mutual return/destruction of Confidential Information at the holder's election — it contains no Customer Data return, export deadline, certified deletion, or transition assistance, so the 'missing' classification (below even the 90-day/30-day fallback) is correct for a hosted auction-platform service.

The inserted subsections (v)-(vi) track the model language closely (6 months' assistance at then-current rates, 30-day machine-readable return, subsequent deletion with written certification) and are tailored to the contract's own terms (Content, Requests, Kubient), with clause numbering continuing correctly from (iv).
The edit is additive and minimal — no existing text is altered — and is placed in the correct effects-of-termination paragraph as the redline guidance directs.
Comment is accurate, concise, in the required voice with the [Playbook] prefix, explains the gap and cites the fallback (90 days) as a negotiable landing spot.
